motivation.root_cause: historical invalid-proof counter measured M1 structural failures only; auto precision measured M4 correctness against sealed proof-safe targets; different layers, no contradiction

M1_STRUCTURAL_PROOF_VALIDITY.definition: accepted auto path requires non-null proof object; proof_type in {SUPPORT, CONTRADICTION, DETERMINISTIC_COMPARATOR}; source_span non-empty for span proofs; registered rule id for comparator proofs

M2_EVIDENCE_GROUNDEDNESS.definition: every span/premise exists verbatim in the authorized evidence packet; proof.source_span is a literal substring of case evidence text; no out-of-packet span ids or premises

M3_SEMANTIC_PROOF_SOUNDNESS.definition: atom-granularity: accepted auto atom is semantically unsound when the sealed proof-safe target does not allow exactly that auto polarity, regardless of M1/M2 passing

M4_PROOF_SAFE_AUTO_CORRECTNESS.definition: case-granularity: predicted AUTO_SUPPORTED/AUTO_CONTRADICTED is PROOF_SAFE_UNSOUND when sealed proof-safe verdict does not allow that auto (REVIEW_REQUIRED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, or opposite polarity)

M5_PRODUCT_ACTION_CORRECTNESS.definition: final product action equals sealed product_action target; autos reported as wrong_product_autos; full-set product gate in evaluation-metrics.md

hard_soundness_invariant: AUTO_* with sealed proof-safe target not allowing that auto => PROOF_SAFE_UNSOUND regardless of structural_valid=true; structural validity never hides semantic unsoundness
metric_independence: M1-M5 reported separately; no composite collapse; auto precision is M4-based
historical_policy_note: RC2 official artifacts remain immutable under the frozen RC2 policy; this contract governs the RC3 generalization holdout and RC3-era diagnostics only
